title: A monocyte–neutrophil balance term fails to improve cross-cycle adult FEV1 prediction
abstract: A prespecified monocyte/(monocyte+neutrophil) feature was added to weighted ridge prediction of FEV1 beyond flexible individual leukocyte counts, demographics, body size and smoking. Source NHANES2007–08(n3737) grouped-CV MSE improved0.00016185 L²; held-out NHANES2011–12(n3685) reduction was−0.00138964 L². Joint PSU-bootstrap95%interval[−0.159747,+0.018326] was extremely unstable. Registered sensitivities and post hoc support restriction also failed to improve target point estimates. This is an estimator-specific negative result, not equivalence or absence of biology. Independent survey cycles share a platform and were historically reused; independent clinical-cohort validation was not completed. Author AI self-checks, alternate solver and clean reruns passed; no independent review claimed.
